verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs claim DLSS Super Resolution and Multi Frame Generation boost FPS, generating up to five frames per rendered frame. TechPowerUp's independent review confirms 'good gaming performance' but finds the gen-over-gen uplift smaller than expected. That is a muted corroboration rather than a concrete contradiction of the vendor claims. missing for 10: specific 4K game benchmark numbers showing high-refresh frame rates, independent validation of the Multi Frame Generation FPS claims, game-level (not compute) benchmark comparisons.
